mira (PM): Quick heads up — infra perf regressions push our launch ~2w. We need a strict MVP stowage + roll‑forward plan by EOD. My strawman below, please react with ✅/❌ and owners.
jon (ENG): Can you list exactly what you mean by 'stowage'? i.e., behave like a cutlist?
mira (PM): Yep — features we remove from MVP surface but keep in a tracked 'stowage' backlog for v1. Minimal runtime impact, reversible.
ara (ENG): Quick note: anything touching KV cache or model routing will affect latency SLOs. prefer to avoid those in stowage.
mira (PM): Agreed. Proposal: keep core runtime, routing, caching primitives. Stowage candidate list: 
```
STOWAGE (proposed):
- embeddings-cache-v2 (perf refactor, not required for initial hit rate)
- tenant-routing-async (opt, adds complexity to rollout)
- promptstore-advanced-search (nice-to-have UX)
- rollout-dashboard-enhanced (dash 2.0)
```
lee (INFRA): +1 on stowage list. One caveat: telemetry retention expansion (90d) is an enterprise ask — cannot fully drop, but we can reduce to baseline for MVP.
mira (PM): Proposal update: keep telemetry baseline (30d) for MVP; mark retention-90d as stowage for v1.
sam (PRODUCT): Need clear acceptance criteria for what we call 'MVP ready' so eng can gate work. Suggest these three quick checks: 1) core flows working end-to-end, 2) latency within SLO on stage, 3) no enterprise blocker (auth/data).
jon (ENG): I'll own the latency verification. Plan: run 48h perf soak on staging after fixes and before canary.
ara (ENG): I'll sketch the perf soak plan and required harness changes. ETA EOD.
lee (INFRA): For rollout: propose roll-forward window + fallback policy. Canary in region pair A->B for 48h, then GA if error rate <0.5% and median latency < target. If regressions, auto-fallback to previous model variant. ops-bot: I can automate the canary checks if you give me thresholds.
mira (PM): Thresholds: error rate 0.5%, p95 latency delta <= +15% vs baseline. ops-bot: acked, will create alert + auto-fallback playbook.
sam (PRODUCT): We should notify pilot customers about a possible 2w shift and list what's in stowage. I'll draft a short note.
jon (ENG): Action owners: Jon -> perf soak & canary check scripts. Ara -> harness + KV smoke. Lee -> alerting + auto-fallback. Sam -> customer comms. Mira -> update roadmap + stowage ticket tracking.
mira (PM): Consensus check — everyone OK with stowage list + rollout thresholds? react with ✅ to lock.
lee (INFRA): ✅
jon (ENG): ✅
ara (ENG): ✅
sam (PRODUCT): ✅
ops-bot: ✅ (automations created: canary-checks/1810004321)
mira (PM): Thanks — I'll post updated roadmap slice and create a single PRD that lists MVP acceptance criteria + stowage tickets. If anything changes, call out in this thread.
jon (ENG): One more: if we later need to pull a stowed item back into MVP because of a sales ask, we need a fast lane. Let's flag that as 'stowage fast-track' with clear cost/infra impact.
mira (PM): Good call — adding 'fast-track request' template to stowage tickets. Closing for now, will post artifacts shortly.
